title: Spinup thresholds scratchpad (Omar)
body:
Personal scratchpad: spinup threshold experiments — measuring cold->active spin-up latency of dedicated GPU pools when autoscaler adds instances based on qps thresholds. Runner: k6 synthetic load, model: llama-13b-q4, svc: dedicated-us-west, cache priming: enabled/disabled toggles.

Experiment config:
- target_service: inference-dedicated-prod-sim
- model_variant: llama-13b-q4
- load_gen: k6 v0.43
- step pattern: 0 -> 50 -> 200 -> 800 qps, ramp 60s each
- autoscaler policy: add-on-qps: [thresholds tested 100, 200, 400], cooldown 30s, spinup_timeout 120s

Run logs (selected):
2026-02-10T14:02:05Z START ramp to 50 qps
14:02:20Z instances=1 qps=50 p50=42ms p95=120ms p99=280ms warm_cache_hit=0%
14:03:05Z ramp to 200 qps triggered; autoscaler threshold=100 -> decision add 1 instance
14:03:12Z new_instance_started (init 7s) GPU ready at 14:03:19Z
14:03:35Z effective throughput=180 qps p50=58ms p95=220ms p99=520ms warm_cache_hit=12%
14:08:01Z ramp to 800 qps initiated; staircase scaling observed, added 4 instances over 42s
14:08:30Z instances=6 qps=760 p50=120ms p95=360ms p99=1.2s warm_cache_hit=45%

Summary table (condensed):
step | target_qps | scaled_to | time_to_ready | p95   | p99   | cache_hit
50   | 50         | 1         | 0s            | 120ms | 280ms | 0%
200  | 200        | 2         | 14s           | 220ms | 520ms | 12%
800  | 800        | 6         | 42s (stair)   | 360ms | 1.2s  | 45%

Key observations:
- spinup wall-clock dominated by container bootstrap (7-12s) + model load (5-20s depending on quant/ckpt).
- cache priming reduces p99 dramatically after first instance warmed: p99 drop ~60% when warm_cache_hit >30%.
- autoscaler with threshold 100 is too aggressive for bursty workloads (adds instances slowly, increased p99 during staircase growth). Threshold=200 gave smoother latency but overshoots capacity if bursts exceed 2x sustained.
- short cooldowns (<=30s) cause flapping under sawtooth traffic; 60s improved stability.

Quick action items:
- rerun with pre-warm hook (warm cache snapshot restore) to test sub-5s spinup.
- prototype instant-start lightweight container (deferred model load) to accept requests with degraded p95 then promote.
- document recommended autoscaler defaults for dedicated pools: threshold 200, cooldown 60s, max-burst-backoff 2x.

Notes to self:
- compare model snapshot restore times across q4 vs fp16.
- attach raw k6 traces: linked_artifact RT-4321 (TODO)

End of scratchpad.
